Elina Svitolina ( Ukrainian : Еліна Світоліна , pronounced [eˈl⁽ʲ⁾inɐ s⁽ʲ⁾wiˈtɔl⁽ʲ⁾inɐ] ; [ 3 ] born 12 September 1994) is a Ukrainian professional tennis player. She has career-high rankings of world No. 3 in singles and No. 108 in doubles by the WTA . Svitolina has won 19 WTA Tour singles titles, including the 2018 WTA Finals and four Premier 5 -level tournaments, and has reached four major semifinals.
